# Alvorlig blødning

Komplikation blandt patienter med atrieflimren, målt efter ISTH-kriterier som indikator 7.

## Mentions

- Page 107: "Indikator 7 Incidens alvorlig blødning" [^src1]
- Page 107: "Incidens af alvorlig blødning (tillempede International Sociaty of Thrombosis and Hemostasis (ISTH) kriterier) blandt prævalente patienter med atrieflimren" [^src1]
- Page 77: "Supplerende analyser 7: Alvorlig blødning. Prævalente patienter med atrieflimren, der udvikler alvorlig blødning i opgørelses perioden" [^src2]

## Relationships

- [[international-society-of-thrombosis-and-hemostasis|International Society of Thrombosis and Hemostasis]] — defined-by-criteria-from [^src1]. Evidence: "Incidens af alvorlig blødning (tillempede International Sociaty of Thrombosis and Hemostasis (ISTH) kriterier)" (Page 107)
- [[indikator-11-serious-bleeding-newly-diagnosed|Indikator 11: Andelen af nydiagnosticerede patienter med atriflimren, som får alvorlig blødning inden for 1 år]] — is-tracked-by [^src2]. Evidence: "Serious bleeding is the outcome measured by Indicator 11" (Page 77)

## Claims

- Indikator 7 måler incidens af alvorlig blødning efter tilpassede ISTH-kriterier blandt prævalente patienter med atrieflimren ([[alvorlig-bloedning|Alvorlig blødning]])
- Among all prevalent atrial fibrillation patients, 2,929 (2.14%) developed serious bleeding, while 134,161 (97.86%) did not ([[atrieflimren|Atrieflimren]], [[alvorlig-bloedning|Alvorlig blødning]])
- Among patients receiving DOAC anticoagulation, 2,349 (2.30%) developed serious bleeding compared to 99,866 (97.70%) who did not ([[doac|DOAC]], [[alvorlig-bloedning|Alvorlig blødning]])
- Among patients receiving Marevan, 154 (2.38%) developed serious bleeding compared to 6,321 (97.62%) who did not ([[marevan|Marevan]], [[alvorlig-bloedning|Alvorlig blødning]])
- Among patients receiving both DOAC and Marevan, 69 (6.45%) developed serious bleeding compared to 1,000 (93.55%) who did not ([[doac|DOAC]], [[marevan|Marevan]], [[alvorlig-bloedning|Alvorlig blødning]])
- Among patients receiving neither DOAC nor Marevan, 357 (1.31%) developed serious bleeding compared to 26,974 (98.69%) who did not ([[alvorlig-bloedning|Alvorlig blødning]])
